qualification: (i) Valid driving license for heavy motor vehicles; (ii) Knowledge of motor mechanism (able to remove minor defects); (iii) At least 3 years' experience driving a heavy motor vehicle; (iv) Pass in 10th standard from a recognized Board; (v) Must be physically fit and capable of performing strenuous duties
age_limit: Minimum Age: 18 years || Maximum Age: 27 years || The crucial date for determining age is the closing date for receipt of online application. Only Matriculation/SSC certificate issued by the concerned Education Board will be considered as proof of Date of Birth. || Age Relaxation: || No relaxation in age limit will be provided unless the category is filled appropriately in the relevant column of the online application form.
selection_process: All applicants (CA'A', CH, FED-OG, CMTD-OG) must appear in the online Computer Based Test (CBT). || There is no Endurance Test/Skill Test for CA'A' and CH applicants; the final provisional merit for these posts is based on CBT merit only. || For FED(OG): candidates are shortlisted in a ratio of at least 1:15 (vacancy:shortlisted) based on CBT merit for a qualifying Endurance Test (carrying filled sand & water buckets 100m in 45 seconds, 20 squats, 15 push-ups, 15 bent-knee sit-ups), followed by a qualifying Skill Test (driving tests, vehicle mechanism knowledge, tyre-changing, minor repairs, firefighting awareness, etc.). || For CMTD(OG): candidates are shortlisted in a ratio of at least 1:15 based on CBT merit for a qualifying Skill Test (driving on ramp/road, road rules, vehicle mechanism knowledge, routine vehicle checks). There is no Endurance Test for CMTD(OG). || Skill Test/Endurance Test is qualifying in nature only; the final merit list for FED(OG) and CMTD(OG) is based on CBT merit, subject to qualifying in the respective test(s). || In case of a tie in aggregate marks, it is resolved first by Date of Birth (older candidate ranked higher), and if still tied, by alphabetical order of first names. || Provisional appointment is strictly based on relative merit position in the CBT, subject to document verification, medical examination, and other requirements.
